programme.title: Jada
programme.desc: Jada, a school teacher, feels trapped in her mundane life with her FBI husband, James. When James forgets her birthday and neglects her for work, Jada seeks excitement and cheats with a dangerous criminal suspect, Maine. Things take a turn for the worse.

programme.title: Killin' Jim Kelly
programme.desc: Black cowboy Jim Kelly is known on the Texas frontier for killing cattle rustlers and trespassers. When he befriends the widow of a murdered sharecropper and her daughter, Jim must decide whether to seek vengeance or leave behind a life of violence.
